mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What kind of URL to check: product item pages or seller/store pages.

startUrls.title: AliExpress URLs
startUrls.description: List of AliExpress URLs to check. For product mode use item pages (e.g. https://es.aliexpress.com/item/1005008991183191.html); for seller mode use store pages (e.g. https://www.aliexpress.com/store/1101692994). Each URL is checked independently. In product mode the market is read from the URL itself (the locale subdomain or the gatewayAdapt stamp) and the check runs on that storefront through a residential proxy in that same country — paste the URL exactly as your buyers see it, since a product can be live in one country and gone in another. URLs without a regional signal (www./m.) are checked as US.

verifyShipTo.title: Verify the product ships to the market
verifyShipTo.description: Product mode only. The page HTML only reveals whether a listing still EXISTS — a product that is live but not shipped to your market returns a page that is byte-for-byte indistinguishable from an available one, because AliExpress loads all product data client-side. With this on, the Actor additionally asks the same signed API the page itself calls, so "not available in your location" is reported as unavailable instead of available. Turn it off to fall back to the faster HTML-only check, which detects deleted listings only.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of product URLs checked in parallel. Keep low (3-5) to avoid triggering AliExpress anti-bot.

sameDomainDelaySecs.title: Delay between requests (seconds)
sameDomainDelaySecs.description: Minimum delay between consecutive requests to AliExpress. Increasing this (e.g. 2-5) reduces blocking.

maxRequestRetries.title: Max request retries
maxRequestRetries.description: How many times to retry a URL (with a fresh session/proxy) when it appears blocked, before recording it as an error.
